commits.subject: fix(check-results): remove duplicate Bluesky posting from safety-net cron
commits.body:
Scheduler's result polling already posts the ❌/✅ reply. The 1am
check-results cron had no guard, causing a second "Streak reset to 0"
reply on miss days. Cron now only updates the local pick file.
